hooks.command: if [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.mcp-servers/youtube/package.json" ] && [ ! -d "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.mcp-servers/youtube/node_modules" ]; then npm install --prefix "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.mcp-servers/youtube" --no-audit --no-fund >/tmp/youtube-mcp-install.log 2>&1 || echo 'youtube-mcp: npm install failed, see /tmp/youtube-mcp-install.log' >&2; fi
